payload.comment: All four review artefacts (ingestion, preprocessing, profiling, experiment_design) and the data_profile are internally consistent. Split sizes (89996+10004+7180=107180) match official PathMNIST; class-count arrays sum to split totals; train imbalance 12885/7886≈1.634 verified; n_classes=9, 28×28×3, schema 1.0, seed 42 uniform. deterministic_findings is empty. The recurring prose discrepancy (test imbalance cited as ≈3.64 vs. structured 1338/339≈3.95) is a narrative-only inaccuracy in data_profile.ambiguity_risks; no pipeline logic, metric computation, or downstream stage consumes that prose value, so it remains non-blocking. The future-dated created_at (2026-09-08) is a system-clock artefact with no reproducibility impact. No deterministic findings to resolve. Training stage may proceed.
llm_issues: Recurring cosmetic prose error: data_profile.ambiguity_risks states test-set max/min ≈ 3.64, but structured class_counts yield 1338/339 ≈ 3.95; flagged in ≥3 prior reviews, structured data is correct, no pipeline dependency on the prose value.
created_at timestamp 2026-09-08 is future-dated (system-clock artefact); no impact on data integrity or reproducibility.
